AppCompatibility.title: App compatibility by schema version
AppCompatibility.caption: Which schema version of protocol each Network Canvas app can open, grouped by app generation.
AppCompatibility.oneWayBody: Only Architect upgrades a protocol to schema 9, and only when you choose to; it makes an upgraded copy and leaves the original unchanged. No app can convert a protocol back to an older schema version, so keep a copy of your original protocol file if you need to continue using apps that only support an older schema. Releases of Interviewer and Fresco made before schema 9 open schema 7 and 8 protocols only, so update them before you use a schema 9 protocol.
